_README: Source-digest input for scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py (pipeline step 1a, 2026-09-06). Each driver entry lists per-key knot rates with the source citation and confidence, so the emitted trajectories_v{N}.json is REPRODUCIBLE from committed inputs rather than hand-edited. TODAY these knot values are the same illustrative headline figures previously typed into the artifact; the pipeline shape is what step 1a locks in. Real per-country/industry extractions (PWT 10.01, UN WPP 2024, EU KLEMS 2023, NGFS) drop in here later (see docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md), replacing the headline knots with reproducible pulls WITHOUT changing the build script or the artifact schema.

provenance.source: UN WPP 2024 (population) + ILO/World Bank (participation) + Penn World Table 10.01 (productivity) + EU KLEMS 2023 (sector productivity/deepening/source labour shares) + IEA WEO 2024/NGFS (emissions intensity)
provenance.licence: see per-entry sources; UN WPP: CC BY 3.0 IGO, PWT 10.01: CC BY 4.0, ILOSTAT/WB: CC BY 4.0, EU KLEMS: CC BY 4.0
provenance.notes: Documented, sourced per-region and per-sector annual growth trajectories for the Phase 7b.2 structural drivers, ASSEMBLED FROM data/structural/sources/inputs.json by scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py (pipeline step 1a — reproducible, not hand-edited). v2 adds source_labour_shares (source-period labour shares s_L^src for the source-side MFP identification, review P1 2026-09-06). Rates are decimal fractions per year, entered as dated knots from the cited published figures; the wrapper holds the most recent knot piecewise-constant. Regions are the model's illustrative multi-region labels N (North, a developed-economy proxy) and S (South, an emerging-economy proxy) plus a global __all__ default; on a real EXIOBASE build these map to actual country/region trajectories via the same loader. Figures remain illustrative headline values, not consulting-grade extractions — see docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md.

BRD.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — sectoral labour-productivity growth; goods-producing/manufacturing sectors run above the economy average (~1.5%/yr). https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

MIL.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — services/mixed sectors run below the goods average (~0.8%/yr). https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

__all__.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — economy-average sectoral labour-productivity growth ~1.0%/yr. https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

BRD.source: IEA World Energy Outlook 2024 / NGFS Net Zero 2050 — carbon-intensive sectors decarbonise ~3%/yr near-term accelerating to ~5%/yr toward mid-century. https://www.iea.org/reports/world-energy-outlook-2024 ; https://www.ngfs.net/ngfs-scenarios-portal/

__all__.source: IEA WEO 2024 / NGFS Net Zero 2050 — economy-wide CO2 intensity of GDP declines ~2%/yr near-term to ~3.5%/yr mid-century. https://www.iea.org/reports/world-energy-outlook-2024 ; https://www.ngfs.net/ngfs-scenarios-portal/

BRD.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — sector capital services per hour worked (g_K/L); capital-intensive goods-producing/manufacturing sectors deepen ~1.0-1.2%/yr. Used to net capital deepening out of observed labour productivity via the Cobb-Douglas finite-change mapping 1+g_phi = [(1+g_Y/L)/(1+g_K/L)^s_K]^(1/s_L). https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

MIL.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — services/mixed sectors deepen more slowly (~0.6%/yr capital services per hour). https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

__all__.source: EU KLEMS 2023 release — economy-average capital deepening ~0.8%/yr (capital services per hour worked). https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

BRD.source: ILLUSTRATIVE headline source-period labour share of value added for goods-producing/manufacturing archetype (~0.58). Placeholder for an EU KLEMS adjacent-period Törnqvist labour cost share; see docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md step 1b. https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

MIL.source: ILLUSTRATIVE headline source-period labour share for services/mixed archetype (~0.62, more labour-intensive). Placeholder for an EU KLEMS Törnqvist share; see docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md step 1b. https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/

__all__.source: ILLUSTRATIVE economy-average source-period labour share (~0.60). Placeholder for an EU KLEMS Törnqvist share; see docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md step 1b. https://euklems-intanprod-llee.luiss.it/
